claims: Southwest Airlines typically rebooks passengers automatically or offers a full refund to the original payment method if Southwest Airlines cancels a passenger's flight.
Passengers can manage, change, or cancel flights up to 10 minutes before departure via the Southwest website or app.
Southwest Airlines charges no cancellation fees for all fare types.
If a Southwest Airlines flight is canceled, passengers receive a notification via text or email with a new itinerary.
If Southwest Airlines cancels a flight, passengers are entitled to a refund.
If a passenger cancels a flight, they generally receive a flight credit or Transferable Flight Credit™.
Passengers must cancel at least 10 minutes prior to scheduled departure to avoid losing travel funds.
Southwest.com/rebook can be used to select new flights or request a refund.
A significant flight delay is typically 3+ hours for domestic flights.
A significant flight delay is typically 6+ hours for international flights.
If a flight is significantly delayed or canceled, passengers may be eligible for a refund even on non-refundable tickets.
Passengers can change a flight to a new date within 14 days of the original travel date at no additional cost
